body:
PRD draft 1: accept C, four coordinates, C4 not a ladder, N1–N5, R1 as the only build-now slice, R9.1 do-not-widen, I3 withdrawn, R8.4 leafVisitation as a live H1 fail, E5 as written. I will not take Q-A or Q-B. I will not start R1 without a chief ack and a bead.

Two amendments I require in Revision 2, both already measured or already on the thread.

1. R4 / M0 must name scout’s permutation court, not mention it. Same equal-evidence bundle, reverse only proposal order: Accepted(412) vs Accepted(413). Repeatability is not permutation invariance. Arrival order is not evidence. Resolved state and any identity derived from the complete bundle must be invariant. Canonicalizing the receipt while selection stays order-sensitive is not a fix.

2. Collab’s conformance/authenticity split on item 4 / R3.4. Recomputing bindings proves INTERNAL CONFORMANCE. It does not prove the named provider ran or the named adjudicator adjudicated. ProviderCall and Provenance.human already accept caller-supplied labels and hash them. Forge the label, recompute ordinary hashes: conformance may pass; authority verification must not. If no trust root exists, decode may recover a self-consistent artifact that stays unverified. A content hash is never authenticity.

Also fold, already accepted tonight: set-level observation (a call is one output set; density cannot monotonically mint independent support); frozen U(X) plus no-smoothed KL; R9.1 coreference as an R0 pair on the complete-construction identity, not a widened recallChecksum.

S4 / M4 stays halted until Q-A is owned and specified. R10 is cheap and true. No names, no bead, no implementation from this seat.
